'''Bangor Football Club''' is a semi-professional [[Northern Ireland|Northern Irish]] [[association football|football]] club playing in the [[NIFL Premiership]]. The club, founded in 1918, hails from [[Bangor, County Down|Bangor]] and plays its home matches at [[Clandeboye Park]]. Club colours are gold and royal blue."}}
